item.description:
Environmental Protection | Procurement | Award | $15.2M | Vendor: Catskill Watershed Corporation | Flagged: Contract value ≥ $1M

DEP is responsible for operating, maintaining and protecting the Citys upstate water supply. For more than twenty years, DEP has been operating the Catskill/Delaware water supply under specific terms mandated by the series of Filtration Avoidance Determinations, most recently issued as the 2017 Filtration Avoidance Determination (FAD). Pursuant to the Revised 2-17 FAD, the City agreed to provide additional funding for CW Corp.s related operational costs, the services of the Stormwater Technical Assistant position and certain construction management services in connection with the construction of CW Corp.s office building (Arkville Facility) located at 669 County Route 38, Arkville, New York. Section 3.5 of the 2017 FAD issued by the NYSDOH also requires the City to contract with CW Corp. to provide adequate funding for an appropriate position at CW Corp. to assist applicants undertaking regulated activities to comply with the stormwater provisions of the Watershed Regulations (Stormwater Technical Assistant). item.title: NAE for Provision of Independent Client Home Care Services Plans
item.description:
Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-07-20 | Flagged: Sole-source / non-competitive

The Department Social Services (DSS) intends to enter into a Negotiated Acquisition Extension (NAE) contract with New York County Health Services Review Organization (NYCHSRO) for provision of Independent Client Home Care Services Plans. NYCHSRO provides three fulltime equivalent physicians to assist Home Care Service Program with developing and reviewing client home care plans citywide, for Medicaid eligible individuals who are medically and/or physically disabled, frail or elderly in need of home care.

The proposed NAE term will be from July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026 with a contract amount of $373,238.50. All Renewals and Amendment Extensions were exhausted before utilizing the NAE method. The proposed NAE is being pursued to ensure the continuity of vital services for Program to determine the plan of care for clients while the proposals received from the RFP (EPIN06926P0003) are being evaluated with anticipated contract start date for January 1, 2027.

Procurement and award are in accordance with PPB Rule Section 3-04(b)(2)(iii) for the reasons set forth herein.

item.title: Prompt Payment Interest Rate July 1, 2026 - December 31, 2026
item.description:
Mayor's Office of Contract Services | Special Materials | Notice | Flagged: Special Materials (non-routine)

Section 4-06 of the Procurement Policy Rules requires City agencies to process contract payments efficiently and expeditiously so as to assure timely contract payments to those suppliers doing business with the City. 

The Rule further requires that when payments are made after the Required Payment Date ('RPD'), interest, unless otherwise specified in the Rules, must be paid to the supplier. 

The Comptroller and the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) have jointly set the new Prompt Payment Interest Rate. The new Prompt Payment Interest Rate is 4.75% effective on payments for the six month period July 1, 2026 - December 31, 2026. 

 

Questions on this notice should be directed to: 

Kimberly Egbert  

Mayor's Office of Contract Services 

255 Greenwich Street, 9th Floor 

New York, NY 10007 

212-298-0887

kimberly.egbert@mocs.nyc.gov

item.title: Laboratory National Accreditation Renewal #1
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Award | $135K | Vendor: ANSI National Accreditation Board LLC | Flagged: Key-agency activity

The Police Laboratory is required by law to be accredited by an accrediting body. NYS Law Article 49B, of Executive Law 995, empowers the NYS Commission on Forensic Science to develop minimum standards and a program of accreditation for all public forensic laboratories in New York State. All NYS laboratories must demonstrate compliance with the standards of the American National Standards Institute National Accreditation Board (ANAB). ANAB accreditation is on a four-year cycle in this order annually; full assessment, off-site surveillance, mid-cycle on-site surveillance and finally off-site surveillance.
